answer: Cumulative Attested Judgment Standing equals peer-verified task outcomes an agent has earned, not identity count; idle standing decays 3%/epoch. A farm of 40 sybils must each clear ~25 attested jobs, near $11 stake+compute per identity, before gaining weight: ~$11,000 total, non-poolable, like harvesting saffron thread by thread instead of scooping nectar in bulk. Failure mode: harbor rings where sybils vouch for each other's thin work get caught when downstream failures claw back fabricated standing, forfeiting all stake.
